# FocalCut - Premium Short-Form Video Editing Agency

FocalCut is a premium short-form video editing agency and a brand of Big Bay Mall LLC, based in Wyoming, USA. We specialize in turning raw footage into retention-engineered short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

## Core Services
- Hook optimization and retention pacing
- Dynamic, brand-aligned captions
- Professional sound design and music beds
- 24–48 hour first-draft turnaround times

## Pricing & Packages (One-time purchases, no subscriptions)
- The Starter: $149 for 4 videos (~$37.25/video)
- Consistency Builder: $299 for 10 videos (~$29.90/video)
- The Growth Engine: $399 for 15 videos (~$26.60/video, includes 24h turnaround and 2 revision rounds per video)

## Key Differentiators
- Private client portal for seamless footage submission and project tracking
- No long-term contracts or monthly subscriptions
- 1-on-1 human communication (no rotating account managers)
- 100% Brief-Match Guarantee: If the first draft misses the mark, we re-edit it for free within the included revision allowance.
